title: HireOnCall Call 1 — HR job profile
description: Structured result CALL-E must return after the hiring-manager call. Skill chips in the HR portal are this list — they become Call 2 questions.

roleName.description: Job title as the hiring manager said it, e.g. Laravel Developer.

mustHaveSkills.description: 3–6 must-have skills spoken on the call. Do not invent skills.

budget.description: Optional CTC / budget band. Empty string if not given.

interviewSlots.description: Screening slots the hiring manager can offer.

jdSummary.description: 2–4 sentence JD written from what they said, not a generic template.
